concernStatuses.concern: Initialization may admit concurrent Web work before commit
concernStatuses.finding: Initialization opens ProjectStore before examining the active rollover record. ProjectStore acquires and retains an OS file lock. WorkLease retains the same ProjectStore lock across central native admission and finalization. The specific alleged pre-lock admission race is not supported by the reviewed implementation.
concernStatuses.remainingUncertainty: Full concurrency and crash-restart behavior remains outside this focused source review.

concernStatuses.concern: Activated-child crash recovery may duplicate or corrupt continuation
concernStatuses.finding: The follow function traverses durable parent-child links. check_link validates request identity and origin while preserving the child's recorded activation bit. Continuation persists a dormant child, parent link, and activation in ordered checkpoints. The regression covers interruptions at all three boundaries and asserts idempotent recovery, preserved metadata, and exactly two jobs.
concernStatuses.remainingUncertainty: Real filesystem crash durability and concurrent-controller recovery were not independently exercised.

concernStatuses.concern: Interrupted native finalization may permit duplicate execution
concernStatuses.finding: Native admission retains its project lease through journal finalization. Existing call IDs are rejected, and unresolved earlier calls block new identities. The journal records Requested, PolicyAllowed and Executing before dispatch. Native queue claims are serialized and restricted to READY jobs. An ambiguous-native regression asserts both same-ID and changed-ID replay rejection while an independent project continues.
concernStatuses.remainingUncertainty: Journal/queue crash consistency, installed-runtime behavior, and real interrupted native-process recovery remain unverified by this independent review.
